subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team Members, I am excited to announce that we will be hosting a team building event next Friday at the local park. This event is a great opportunity for us to bond and strengthen our teamwork. There will be various activities and games planned, followed by a BBQ lunch. Please RSVP by the end of the week so we can finalize the arrangements. Looking forward to a fun and productive day together! Best regards, [Your Name]
